institutional_scope: U.S. District Court, District of New Jersey

remedy.notes: At a 2024-07-08 settlement conference the parties reached a settlement in principle, and Magistrate Judge Wettre administratively terminated the action on 2024-07-09 by a 60-day order that is expressly not a Rule 41 dismissal (Dkt. 125). On 2024-09-05 defense counsel filed the executed Settlement Agreement and Release, under which the Township of Woodbridge pays $300,000 with no admission of liability, together with stipulations of dismissal (Dkt. 126). No merits ruling on the facial-recognition claims was issued; defendants' summary-judgment motion was pending when the case settled. An entered dismissal order after Dkt. 126 was not located.
